notes.title: Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother Speed Run Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DfQT9YX3/Speed-Run-Event.png[/img]

Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother is our first game here at Mutts Presents. The game isn't a long game; as a result of this, we want to see just how fast a player can beat this game. We want to see players exploit bugs, glitches, errors, etc so as to get the fastest time possible. 

This event is [b]FREE[/b] to the masses regardless where one is in the world. 

[b]How to participate: [/b]

1.) Download the game from the Steam page.
2.) Play the game as many times as you need to get the fastest time possible. 
3.) Upload your fastest time to Youtube.
4.)Upload the YT link to your SpeedRun.com profile(if you don't have a Speedrun.com profile then of course, you will need to make one).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/V6Z0FLWm/coollogo-com-28046509.png[/img]

[b]1st Place Winner: $400.00 dollar Visa E-Gift Card
2nd Place Winner: $200.00 dollar Visa E-Gift Card[/b]
(Winners will be contacted so as to obtain email address in which their prize can be sent to)
